stem:
Meera cycles along a straight road near her school. Her friend records the distance she covers every 5 seconds.
In which case is Meera's motion uniform motion?

options.text: distance covered each 5 s: 12 m, 12 m, 12 m, 12 m
distance covered each 5 s: 10 m, 14 m, 18 m, 22 m
distance covered each 5 s: 20 m, 15 m, 10 m, 5 m
distance covered each 5 s: 8 m, 20 m, 6 m, 25 m

teacher.key_rationale: Uniform motion means equal distances in equal time intervals; only option A shows equal distances (12 m) in every 5-second interval. Options B and C show changing speed (non-uniform but patterned), and D shows irregular distances (non-uniform).
